def: The perceived aesthetic and cultural identity of the building’s architectural design.
rat: Architectural style conveys prestige, cultural alignment, and emotional resonance, influencing perceived uniqueness and desirability.

def: The visible state of maintenance and integrity of the building’s exterior surfaces.
rat: A well-maintained facade signals good upkeep and reduces perceived future repair costs, enhancing perceived quality.

def: The apparent physical state and maintenance level of the roof.
rat: Roof condition indicates structural soundness and maintenance level, directly affecting perceived durability and value.

def: The perceived quality, modernity, and condition of windows.
rat: Windows influence energy efficiency, comfort, and aesthetic appeal, affecting perceived livability and cost efficiency.

def: The visual appeal and design of the main entrance area.
rat: A welcoming and elegant entryway enhances first impressions and perceived prestige.

def: The visual harmony and integration of the garage with the main structure.
rat: A well-integrated garage design contributes to architectural coherence and perceived property quality.

def: The aesthetic and functional appeal of balconies or terraces.
rat: Outdoor extensions enhance perceived lifestyle quality and relaxation potential.

def: The perceived openness, flow, and functional arrangement of interior spaces.
rat: Efficient and open layouts enhance perceived spaciousness and usability, increasing desirability.

def: The perceived vertical spaciousness of interior rooms.
rat: Higher ceilings evoke luxury and openness, influencing perceived status and comfort.

def: The amount and quality of daylight entering interior spaces.
rat: Natural light enhances mood, comfort, and perceived spaciousness, increasing attractiveness.

def: The dominant color scheme and its harmony within the interior.
rat: Color harmony affects emotional response and perceived warmth or modernity.

def: The visible material quality and condition of flooring surfaces.
rat: High-quality flooring signals durability and comfort, influencing perceived value.

def: The visible state and quality of wall surfaces and finishes.
rat: Well-maintained walls indicate good upkeep and reduce perceived renovation needs.

def: The arrangement and aesthetic of artificial lighting fixtures.
rat: Good lighting enhances ambiance and perceived sophistication.

def: The aesthetic and functional design of the kitchen area.
rat: Kitchen design strongly influences perceived modernity and usability.

def: The visual appeal and modernity of bathroom fixtures and finishes.
rat: Bathrooms are key indicators of property maintenance and luxury level.

def: The visible presence and accessibility of storage areas.
rat: Ample storage enhances perceived functionality and livability.

def: The existence and design of a fireplace as a focal interior element.
rat: Fireplaces evoke warmth and luxury, enhancing emotional and status appeal.

def: The aesthetic and structural design of staircases.
rat: Elegant staircases signal craftsmanship and architectural refinement.

def: The visible texture, design, and condition of ceilings.
rat: Ceiling finishes contribute to perceived attention to detail and maintenance.

def: The perceived balance between room dimensions and furniture scale.
rat: Well-proportioned rooms feel more comfortable and functional.

def: The design and maintenance quality of garden or yard areas.
rat: Landscaping enhances aesthetic appeal and signals care and investment.

def: The presence and design of usable outdoor spaces for leisure.
rat: Outdoor living areas increase perceived lifestyle quality and relaxation potential.

def: The visible level of boundary definition and privacy protection.
rat: Privacy enhances perceived security and comfort.

def: The visible state and material quality of the driveway.
rat: A well-maintained driveway signals good property upkeep.

def: The presence and design of exterior lighting fixtures.
rat: Exterior lighting enhances safety and aesthetic appeal.

def: The visible cleanliness and maintenance of a swimming pool.
rat: A well-kept pool signals luxury and leisure potential.

def: The overall upkeep and cleanliness of outdoor areas.
rat: Maintenance level reflects owner care and property condition.

def: The visible cleanliness and orderliness of the street environment.
rat: Clean streets signal community upkeep and safety.

def: The visible maintenance and quality of adjacent properties.
rat: Well-maintained surroundings enhance perceived neighborhood value.

def: The presence and density of trees along the street.
rat: Tree-lined streets evoke calmness and environmental quality.

def: The apparent level of vehicular traffic near the property.
rat: Lower traffic implies quieter, safer environments.

def: Visual cues suggesting potential noise sources.
rat: Noise exposure reduces perceived tranquility and comfort.

def: The aesthetic and emotional appeal of visible surroundings.
rat: Beautiful views enhance emotional connection and perceived exclusivity.

def: The visible closeness to natural elements or green spaces.
rat: Natural proximity increases perceived well-being and desirability.

def: The perceived compactness and building density of the area.
rat: Lower density implies more privacy and space, enhancing comfort.

def: The visible presence of street lighting and safety features.
rat: Visible safety features increase perceived security and livability.

def: The visual harmony and consistency of architectural styles in the area.
rat: Cohesive neighborhoods appear more prestigious and well-planned.

def: The visible clearness of the air and absence of haze or pollution.
rat: Clear air implies healthy and pleasant living conditions.

def: The visible orientation and sunlight exposure of the property.
rat: Good sun exposure enhances warmth and energy efficiency.

def: The visible elevation and terrain characteristics of the property site.
rat: Elevated sites often convey exclusivity and better views.

def: The visible closeness to lakes, rivers, or the sea.
rat: Water proximity enhances emotional appeal and perceived luxury.

def: The visible abundance of vegetation around the property.
rat: Green surroundings increase perceived tranquility and healthiness.

def: The visible presence of urban landmarks or cityscapes.
rat: Urban views can signal prestige and connectivity.

def: The overall luminance and exposure level of listing photos.
rat: Bright images enhance perceived cleanliness and spaciousness.

def: The clarity and focus quality of listing photos.
rat: Sharp images convey professionalism and transparency.

def: The warmth or coolness of the photo’s color tone.
rat: Warm tones evoke coziness, while cool tones suggest modernity.

def: The framing and perspective used in property photos.
rat: Professional composition enhances perceived property quality.

def: The uniformity of style and lighting across all listing photos.
rat: Consistent imagery signals professional marketing and reliability.

def: The spatial organization of furniture to highlight room functionality.
rat: Good arrangement enhances perceived usability and spaciousness.

def: The aesthetic coherence and tastefulness of interior decor.
rat: Stylish decor enhances emotional appeal and perceived sophistication.

def: The visible tidiness and cleanliness of the staged environment.
rat: Cleanliness signals care and readiness for occupancy.

def: The degree to which the space appears neutral versus personalized.
rat: Neutral staging allows buyers to imagine themselves in the space.

def: The use of artificial lighting to improve visual appeal.
rat: Enhanced lighting improves perceived warmth and attractiveness.

def: The design and condition of window coverings.
rat: Window treatments influence perceived elegance and light control.

def: The clarity with which each room’s purpose is visually communicated.
rat: Clear room functions help buyers visualize practical use.

def: The immediate visual impression of the property’s exterior from the street.
rat: Strong curb appeal creates positive first impressions and perceived prestige.

def: The logical and aesthetic flow of images in the listing sequence.
rat: Cohesive photo sequences enhance comprehension and engagement.

def: The seasonal context visible in photos and its effect on mood.
rat: Seasonal cues influence warmth, vibrancy, and emotional resonance.
